sections.heading: Akshata Murty — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Akshata Murty was born on April 1980.
Public records name her father, N. R. Narayana Murthy and her mother, Sudha Murthy. She is a sibling of Rohan Murthy.
She studied at Baldwin Girls High School, Claremont McKenna College, Fashion Institute of Design & Merchandising and Stanford University.
She is recorded as speaking French, English, Hindi and Kannada.

sections.heading: Akshata Murty — Career and Professional Work

She has held the following offices: businessperson, chief executive officer and trustee (2025–present).
